summary: Iteration 839: Verified the new Flappy daily-challenge home dashboard card end-to-end. Backend: added 7 pytest cases (backend/tests/test_feature37_flappy_daily_challenge_endpoint.py) covering shape, types, auth, value ranges, and cross-check against /bootstrap. All 7 pass. Regression: 41 pre-existing flappy pytest still pass. Frontend: logged in as admin, home dashboard shows home-arcade-challenge card in DONE state with correct copy ('Daily challenge complete!', '1 day streak', 'Best: 9999', CTA 'Play again'). CTA click routes to /features/flappy-bird and the game hub loads. Job Hunt Pulse card appears immediately above the arcade card. No breaking console errors from the arcade card itself; the app-wide 429/CF throttling causes flakiness in aggressive scroll sessions but is unrelated to the new feature.
critical_code_review_comments: HomeArcadeChallenge polls every 120s per user (useLiveQuery). Combined with other home cards this contributed to observed Cloudflare 429s in bot-like scroll sessions. Not a functional issue but worth monitoring aggregate poll pressure on the dashboard.
HomeArcadeChallenge.tsx returns null while data is loading; consider a small skeleton for perceived-performance parity with sibling cards. Non-blocking.
personal_best pill is hidden when personal_best === 0. Fine, but ensure design covers this branch for new users (subtle indicator of no run yet).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for verified flows (card render, testids, values, CTA nav)
